description: This source file defines the ClusterManifestSystemTarget class, which manages and provides access to cluster manifest information and updates within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for retrieving the current cluster manifest, caching updates, and participating in silo lifecycle events.

classes.name: ClusterManifestSystemTarget
classes.description: Manages cluster manifest retrieval and caching, providing updates based on cluster membership status.

methods.name: GetClusterManifestUpdate
methods.description: Provides an update of the cluster manifest if newer than the specified version.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Participates in the silo lifecycle; no actions needed in this implementation.
